integrity: Two exact exhaustive prefix enumerators independently reconstruct every admissible binary word through length 51 and agree on all level sets. Every boundary word is then directly rescanned for cubes and complementary factors at all relevant lengths, followed by exact symmetry-orbit computation.
scientific limitations: The maximum length 50 is prior work. The new content is the complete 16-word equality layer and its four reversal/complement orbits for the cube-free, no-complementary-pair-of-length-at-least-6 obstruction. Unpublished source-author backtracking output could contain the same equality data.
title: Sixteen equality cases at the binary cube-free complement-avoidance boundary
